e08df1896691967b.desc: Gerardo Ortiz is undoubtedly one of Latin music’s most defining artists of the last decade and his wide recognition stems from the chart-topping success of his albums and back-to-back #1 singles. Ortiz has scored more No. 1s than any other solo act in the 24-year-old history of the Billboard Regional Mexican Airplay chart. Gerardo Ortiz is an online and social media powerhouse– with over 22.3 Million followers on social media, and an astounding ONE BILLION and counting views on VEVO. His album, “Comeré Callado” vol.2 (8th studio album) was released in April 2018 and debuted #1 in iTunes Latin and Regional Mexican Chart, it maintained #1 for one week on Billboard Regional Mexican Albums charts.  The album contains 15 band version songs, of which 10 of them are unpublished and 5 are new versions of songs previously published on his last album “Comere Callado” vol. 1. The hit singles included are, the banda ballad “Regresa Hermosa” (Return, Lovely) and the banda heartbreaker “Para Qué Lastimarme” (Why Hurt Me). e08d9313b9d19b97.title: Randy Feltface at Irvine Improv
e08d9313b9d19b97.desc: Welcome to a night of sharp laughs and unexpected charm with Randy Feltface at the Irvine Improv in Irvine—one of the city’s favorite spots for a great night out. Randy Feltface brings the beloved purple puppet’s quick wit and fearless crowd play to town for a show that feels both intimate and wildly unpredictable. Randy’s comedy stands out for its clever storytelling, cheeky honesty, and the way he turns awkward truths into big, genuine laughs—without ever losing that disarming puppet persona. The Irvine Improv offers a cozy, club-style atmosphere with great sightlines and an easy-to-reach location in the heart of Irvine, California. Randy Feltface - Irvine Irvine Improv is the perfect midweek escape on Wednesday, October 14, 2026 at 7:30 PM.
